argv:
set -euo pipefail; discovered="$(go test -list '^TestV2Verifier' ./cmd/leamas 2>&1 | grep '^TestV2' | sort -u)"; required="TestV2VerifierDuplicateMatrixHas56Rows
TestV2VerifierExitThreeMatrixHas13Rows
TestV2VerifierPublicNegativeMatrixHas16Rows
TestV2VerifierTerminalTrailerMatrixHas15Rows
TestV2VerifierJSONSingleDocumentUsesSecondDecode
TestV2VerifierPreObservationCountersAreZero
TestV2VerifierMetadataObsStateMachineHoldsInvariants
TestV2VerifierHelpContractExitsZero"; missing="$(comm -23 <(echo "$required") <(echo "$discovered"))"; if [ -n "$missing" ]; then echo "ZERO_TEST_GUARD_FAILED:"; echo "$missing"; exit 1; fi; exit 0
set -euo pipefail; if [ -z "${F5_COMMIT:-}" ]; then echo 'DIFF_RANGE_UNRESOLVED: F5_COMMIT not provided by closure runner'; exit 2; fi; git diff --check "$F5_COMMIT" HEAD

set -euo pipefail; mkdir -p .factory/build .factory/evidence; BUILD_DIR="$(mktemp -d -p .factory/build v2verifier-r1.XXXXXX)"; out="$BUILD_DIR/leamas-v2verifier-r1"; trap 'rm -rf "$BUILD_DIR"' EXIT; CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -o "$out" ./cmd/leamas; file "$out" > .factory/evidence/built-binary.txt; if command -v ldd >/dev/null 2>&1; then ldd "$out" > .factory/evidence/built-binary.ldd 2>&1 || true; fi; sha256sum "$out" >> .factory/evidence/built-binary.txt; if grep -qE 'statically linked' .factory/evidence/built-binary.txt || (command -v ldd >/dev/null 2>&1 && ldd "$out" 2>&1 | grep -q 'not a dynamic executable'); then echo 'BUILT_BINARY_STATIC=YES' >> .factory/evidence/built-binary.txt; else echo 'BUILT_BINARY_STATIC=NO' >> .factory/evidence/built-binary.txt; exit 1; fi

set -uo pipefail; mkdir -p .factory; raw=.factory/gate-summary.raw; json=.factory/gate-summary.json; derived=.factory/gate-summary.derived; bin/leamas factory gate --lane=fast > "$raw" 2>&1; rc=$?; raw_sha=$(sha256sum < "$raw" | awk '{print $1}'); { echo "aggregate_rc=$rc"; echo "raw_sha256=$raw_sha"; echo "raw_path=$raw"; echo "captured_at=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; } > "$derived"; grep -E '^(agent-context|docs|doctrine|doctrine-agent-contracts|domain-boundaries|exec-gate|executable-contract-first|forbidden-patterns|git-hooks|language|llm-friendly): ' "$raw" | sed 's/^/lane_/' >> "$derived"; grep -E '^--- (exec-gate|forbidden-patterns|llm-friendly) (OK|FAILED|SKIP)' "$raw" >> "$derived" || true; { echo '{'; echo "  \"aggregate_rc\": $rc,"; echo "  \"raw_sha256\": \"$raw_sha\","; echo "  \"raw_path\": \"$raw\","; echo "  \"captured_at\": \"$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)\""; echo '}'; } > "$json"; exit 0

set -euo pipefail; if [ ! -e .factory/gate-summary.json ]; then echo 'GATE_SUMMARY_FRESHNESS=missing'; exit 2; fi; prev=.factory/gate-summary.prev.json; if [ -e "$prev" ] && cmp -s "$prev" .factory/gate-summary.json; then echo 'GATE_SUMMARY_FRESHNESS=stale'; exit 2; fi; echo 'GATE_SUMMARY_FRESHNESS=fresh'; sha256sum .factory/gate-summary.json

set -euo pipefail; head_oid="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"; head_tree="$(git rev-parse HEAD^{tree})"; raw_sha="$(sha256sum < .factory/gate-summary.raw | awk '{print $1}')"; json_sha="$(sha256sum < .factory/gate-summary.json | awk '{print $1}')"; derived_json_sha="$(grep -E '^raw_sha256=' .factory/gate-summary.derived | cut -d= -f2)"; echo "HEAD_OID=$head_oid"; echo "HEAD_TREE=$head_tree"; echo "RAW_SHA=$raw_sha"; echo "JSON_SHA=$json_sha"; echo "DERIVED_RAW_SHA=$derived_json_sha"; if [ "$raw_sha" != "$derived_json_sha" ]; then echo 'DIGEST_SELF_CONSISTENCY=raw_mismatch'; exit 2; fi; echo 'DIGEST_SELF_CONSISTENCY=ok'
